from hep_lfx import HepComponent, business, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class HepScope(HepComponent):
 display_name='核对冻结资产范围'
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value', display_name='value', required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="result",display_name="结果",method="build")]
 async def build(self)->Data:
  return Data(data=business().scope(payload(self.value)))
